PROTESTORS RALLY VS. CORRUPTION AT EDSA SHRINE, MONUMENT

Various progressive groups hold a protest rally on Saturday, Sept. 13, at the EDSA Shrine and People Power Monument in Quezon City to denounce alleged corruption in government infrastructure and flood control project.

(Photos by Ethan Joshua Nikholai F. Guisama and Justin Jacob S. Urag/ The Varsitarian)

data.raw_text:
Malacañang said on Saturday that President Bongbong Marcos Jr. respects the sentiments of the public in relation to the protests condemning alleged corruption in the country’s flood control projects, including the large protest set on September 21 at EDSA.

"The president will always respect this freedom of expression," Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro said.
